BatchCreateDeleteNatGatewayTag.name: BatchCreateDeleteNatGatewayTag
BatchCreateDeleteNatGatewayTag.summary: Batch Adding or Deleting Tags to or from a Public NAT Gateway
BatchCreateDeleteNatGatewayTag.description: - This API is used to batch add or delete tags to or from a public NAT gateway. - TMS needs to use this API to manage tags of resources in batches. - A resource can have up to 20 tags.

BatchCreateDeletePrivateNatTags.name: BatchCreateDeletePrivateNatTags
BatchCreateDeletePrivateNatTags.summary: Batch Adding Tags to or Deleting Tags from a Private NAT Gateway
BatchCreateDeletePrivateNatTags.description: - This API is used to batch add tags to or delete tags from a private NAT gateway. - TMS uses this API to batch manage tags of a private NAT gateway. - A private NAT gateway can have up to 10 tags.

BatchCreateDeleteTransitIpTags.name: BatchCreateDeleteTransitIpTags
BatchCreateDeleteTransitIpTags.summary: Batch Adding Tags to or Deleting Tags from a Transit IP Address
BatchCreateDeleteTransitIpTags.description: - This API is used to batch add tags to or delete tags from a specified transit IP address. - TMS needs to use this API to batch manage tags of a specified transit IP address. - A transit IP address can have up to 10 tags.

BatchCreateDeleteTransitSubnetTags.name: BatchCreateDeleteTransitSubnetTags
BatchCreateDeleteTransitSubnetTags.summary: Batch Adding or Deleting Tags to or from a Transit Subnet
BatchCreateDeleteTransitSubnetTags.description: - This API is used to batch add or delete tags to or from a transit subnet. - TMS uses this API to batch manage tags of a specified transit subnet. - A transit subnet can have up to 20 tags.
